evals.prompt: I want to manage my Spice.ai Cloud infrastructure with Terraform. Write me a complete config that creates an app, adds secrets, and deploys it.
evals.expected_output: Complete Terraform config with provider, data sources for regions/images, spiceai_app, spiceai_secret with for_each, spiceai_deployment with triggers

assertions.name: configures_provider
assertions.description: Should configure the spiceai provider source

evals.prompt: I already have a Spice.ai Cloud app running (app ID 12345). How do I import it into my Terraform state?
evals.expected_output: Use terraform import spiceai_app.name 12345, note that secrets need manual value setting after import

assertions.name: shows_import_command
assertions.description: Should show the terraform import command

assertions.name: uses_correct_resource_type
assertions.description: Should reference the correct resource type
